overall: The AG found the North Adams Airport Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law on the notice, deliberation, and minutes allegations; out-of-scope ethics and c. 90/30B claims were declined. No remedy ordered.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the December 5, 2024 notice was insufficiently specific because no prior notice of a motion to rescind a prior vote was given.
allegations.key_passage: We are satisfied that the topics as listed on the notice here were sufficient to reasonably advise the public of the issues to be discussed at the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged commission members deliberated outside a posted meeting to undermine a prior vote, after individual contacts with the Mayor and an aide.
allegations.key_passage: Absent specific evidence to the contrary, we credit the public body’s version of events that a quorum of members did not deliberate outside of the December 5, 2024, meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the commission did not timely approve the minutes of the October 15, 2024 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find that the Commission approved the minutes in a timely manner and thus did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the chair voted on a matter he had abstained from at an earlier meeting, a conflict-of-interest question.
allegations.key_passage: we decline to review any allegations involving ethics or conflict of interest as the Commonwealth’s Conflict of Interest Law is enforced through the State Ethics Commission.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged two non-members were running the December 5, 2024 meeting and that the commission lacked a majority of members for a vote.
allegations.key_passage: Even if true, these allegations would not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged violations of G.L. c. 90 and c. 30B, which are outside the Division's Open Meeting Law review.
allegations.key_passage: The Division of Open Government’s review concerns compliance with the Open Meeting Law only, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25.
